summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K on June 8, 2026, announcing the closing of a $350 million revolving credit facility with an accordion option for up to $200 million additional capacity, arranged by Goldman Sachs Lending Partners LLC, and a memorandum of understanding to assign a lease with CoreWeave for a data center project. The company also disclosed plans for a subsidiary to offer $1.59 billion in senior secured notes due 2031 to fund construction. This is a capital raising and operational update, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no deal terms applicable.
